system.readyLong: The primary model can be called
system.notReadyLong: The primary model has no key

chart.slider: {{title}}; use the left and right arrow keys for each day

overview.title: Overview
overview.lede: Usage, cost, open work and system state. Numbers only; no patient content.
overview.aiOn: Patient messages go to the model.
overview.aiOff: Only the rules are running; the model is not called.
overview.noPrice: There are model calls but no price, so the cost counts as zero.
overview.queuesNote: Handled in the clinic and pharmacy workspaces. Administrators see counts and cannot open the content.

alert.db: The database connection has a problem; numbers on this page may be old.
alert.aiOffBody: Patient messages are kept but get no AI reply. Red-flag, scope and refill rules still run.
alert.model: The primary model cannot be called
alert.modelBody: The server has no key for this model. Patient messages are kept but get no AI reply.
alert.budgetOver: This month's budget is used up
alert.budgetNear: This month's budget is nearly used up
alert.calls: Model calls are close to today's limit
alert.callsBody: {{used}} of {{limit}} used. After the limit the model is not called again today.
alert.redFlag_one: {{count}} red-flag previsit is on the clinic's list.
alert.redFlag_other: {{count}} red-flag previsits are on the clinic's list.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.lede: Add staff, disable accounts, reset passwords and revoke sign-ins.
accounts.guestNote: Guest sandboxes come from "Try with a demo patient" on the public site. Each belongs to one browser and is deleted after the retention period.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.noMatchBody: Try another username or name, or clear the filters.
accounts.privacy: Administrators manage accounts and cannot see patients' previsits, medicines or messages.

roleHint.physician: Reviews previsits, signs notes, decides renewals
roleHint.coordinator: Organises, contacts and assigns patients; cannot sign or decide renewals
roleHint.pharmacist: Dispenses; sees medicines, allergies and requests only
roleHint.admin: Accounts, settings, audit; cannot see patient content
roleHint.patient: Their own previsits, medicines, appointments and health profile

create.title: Add account
create.body: A one-time password is shown afterwards. Hand it to the person; they replace it at the first sign-in.
create.name: Display name
create.titleHint: Shown beside the name, such as "Family physician"

oneTime.body: This password is shown only once and cannot be looked up later. If it is lost, reset it again.
oneTime.copyFailed: The browser refused to copy. Select the text instead.
oneTime.note: Hand it over in person or by phone, not in a group chat or a record. The person must replace it at the first sign-in.
oneTime.noted: I have noted the password or handed it over

account.title: Account
account.roleHint: Changing the role signs this person out everywhere.
account.patientRole: A patient account cannot become staff, and staff cannot become a patient, because health data belongs to the patient account.
account.lockSelf: You cannot change your own role or disable yourself. Ask another administrator.
account.lockLast: This is the last active administrator, so the role cannot change and the account cannot be disabled. Add another administrator first.
account.roleBody: From {{from}} to {{to}}. Permissions change at once and the person is signed out everywhere.
account.resetHint: Creates a one-time password and signs the person out on other devices.
account.resetNoUsername: This account has no username and cannot sign in with a password.
account.revokeHint_one: Signed in on {{count}} device. The password stays the same, so the person can sign in again.
account.revokeHint_other: Signed in on {{count}} devices. The password stays the same, so the person can sign in again.
account.disableHint: A disabled account cannot sign in. Data and records stay, and it can be enabled again.
account.enableHint: Once enabled, the old password works again.

reset.title: Reset {{name}}'s password
reset.body: The current password stops working at once and other devices are signed out. The new one is shown only once.

revoke.title: Revoke all sign-ins of {{name}}
revoke.body: Those devices leave the system at once; unsaved work may be lost. The device you are using now is not affected.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}
disable.body: The person is signed out at once and cannot sign in. Work assigned to them is not passed on automatically.

enable.title: Enable {{name}}
enable.body: The person can sign in again with the same permissions as before.

account.patientBody: Administrators can disable it, reset the password and revoke sign-ins. They cannot see this person's previsits, medicines or messages.

permissions.title: Roles and permissions
permissions.lede: Every endpoint asks for one permission, checked by the server each time.
permissions.adminBody: The administrator column holds none of the previsit, patient or prescription permissions. Reading content takes a physician, coordinator or pharmacist account, and every read is logged for the patient to see.
permissions.caption: Permissions by role
permissions.fixed: The table is part of the program (backend/src/perm.rs) and cannot be changed here. Individual accounts can change role or be disabled.

settings.newerBody: Your changes are still on this page. Loading the new version keeps your values where nothing clashes.
settings.mergedBody: {{list}}. Your changes are not saved yet; check and save.

problem.same: The fallback cannot be the primary model.
problem.choice: This model is no longer available. Choose another.

setting.ai_on_budget: When the budget is used up

onBudgetHint.fallback: Over budget, replies continue with the fallback model and the cost keeps growing.
onBudgetHint.stop: No model calls until the month ends or the budget is raised. Patients see a fixed text; the rules still run.

ai.title: AI settings
ai.lede: Saved changes apply from the next turn. Every change is written to the audit log.
ai.noHistory: Nobody has changed the settings; the server's environment values are in use.

switch.title: Emergency stop
switch.onBody: If AI replies go wrong, stop all model calls here at once. Rules and human work are not affected.
switch.offBody: The model is not being called. Patient messages are kept and answered with a fixed text.
switch.stopLede: Applies from the next patient message. Replies already sent stay as they are.
switch.startLede: The next patient message goes to the model.
switch.stops1: AI replies to patients; they see a fixed text and "Ask the clinic to contact me"
switch.stops2: History taking by the model; summaries hold only what the patient has filled in
switch.stops3: Handbook search and tool calls by the model
switch.keeps1: Red-flag and scope rules, refill checks, renewal protocols: these are program rules
switch.keeps2: Physician review, takeover, renewal decisions and dispensing
switch.keeps3: Patients can still write, submit previsits and send requests
switch.sure: I know patients will get no AI reply while it is off
switch.startBody: Uses the saved models, limits and budget. Messages left while it was off are not answered afterwards.
switch.separate: This is saved on its own; other unsaved changes on the page are kept.

models.title: Models
models.fallbackHint: Used when the primary times out or fails
models.thinkingHint: Higher levels are slower and use more output tokens.
models.temperatureHint: 0 to 2. Lower values give steadier replies.
models.stepsHint: 1 to 12. How often one turn may call the model.
models.choices: The list comes from the server's LLM_MODEL_CHOICES variable.

budget.title: Budget and usage limits
budget.hint: Estimated from the prices below. Leave empty for no limit.
budget.callsHint: Model calls per day for the whole site. After that, none until tomorrow.
budget.clientHint: Model calls per day from one source.
budget.unpriced: The cost of {{list}} counts as zero and never reaches the budget. Set a price first.
budget.noFallback: No fallback model is set, so reaching the budget stops the calls.
budget.zero: A budget of 0 is used up right away.

prices.title: Prices
prices.lede: For estimates only; the provider's bill is separate. Copy the published prices.
prices.empty: No prices yet, so every cost counts as zero.

limits.title: Limits
limits.lede: Stops a source from sending a lot in a short time and keeps previsits from growing without end.
limits.maxHint: After that the patient is asked to submit or to reach a person

sla.title: Time limits for renewals
sla.lede: Counted from submission. A late request is marked overdue and the people who can decide are notified; nothing is decided automatically. Urgent requests do not use these limits.
sla.phase: Oversight phase {{n}}, read only. A physician decides every request; there is no switch here to change that.

oversight.title: Oversight
oversight.lede: How far the rule engine and the physicians differ, and how fast requests move. Counts only, no patient data.
oversight.reversed: The start cannot be after the end.
oversight.progressLabel: {{n}} cases; leaving phase 1 needs at least {{total}}
oversight.howAgreement: Agreement means the engine said "ready" and the physician approved, or it said "in person" or "urgent" and the physician asked for a visit or declined. The denominator is the decided items minus those the engine only marked for review ("Left out"), because it made no prediction there.
oversight.small: With few cases the rate jumps a lot; do not compare classes by it.
oversight.bias: Physicians see the engine's result before deciding, which pushes agreement up. There is no comparison group without it.
oversight.emptyBody: Choose another period, or wait for requests.
oversight.turnaroundNote: The return rate counts requests that reached a pharmacy.
oversight.noRedFlags: No red flags in this period.
oversight.redNote: Rule hits; one patient can have several.
oversight.noGuard: Nothing was stopped in this period.
oversight.guardNote: Model replies the program rewrote or replaced before sending.
oversight.noPatients: Administrators cannot see the patients behind these numbers. For a single case, someone in the clinic opens it from patient management.

phase.title: Oversight phase {{n}}
phase.now: A physician reviews and decides every renewal. The engine only decides what the physician sees and where it is placed; it approves nothing.
phase.noSwitch: There is no button to raise the phase and no automatic approval in the program.
phase.need1Any: Enough physician decisions in every class
phase.need2: Agreement above a threshold set and published beforehand, with every disagreement reviewed
phase.need3: Approval by an ethics board and the regulator
phase.need4: A medical institution and a named physician who carry the responsibility
phase.none: The threshold has not been set, and none of these conditions is met today.

runs.title: Runs
runs.lede: Which model and tools each AI turn used, how many tokens, and whether it failed.
runs.noText: Nothing a patient said and no model reply is here. Tools show name, result and time; arguments and content never reach the admin workspace.
runs.emptyBody: They appear after a patient sends a message.

run.title: Run
run.noToolsBody: For example a fixed reply by a rule, or a failure before the model was called.
run.privacyBody: Administrators cannot open this previsit; the ID is only for matching with the clinic. A physician or coordinator can open it from the clinic workspace, and that read is logged.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lede: Who changed what, and who read whose data, and when.
audit.window: Without dates, the list starts at {{date}}.
audit.privacy: Reads of patient data show an ID only; administrators cannot open that data. Look after exported files yourself.
audit.noMatchBody: Widen the dates or clear the filters.
audit.cannotOpen: Administrators cannot open this record; the ID is for matching only.
audit.exportedPart_one: The latest {{count}} entry was exported and there are more. Narrow the dates to export the rest.
audit.exportedPart_other: The latest {{count}} entries were exported and there are more. Narrow the dates to export the rest.

rulesPage.title: Rules
rulesPage.lede: The rules the system is using right now. Read only.
rulesPage.change: To change a rule, edit these files, run the tests and the evaluation, and deploy again. It cannot be done here.

eval.title: Evaluation
eval.lede: A fixed set of cases run against the real model, to see whether rules and limits hold.
eval.noneBody: Run the evaluation once in the project folder; results go to data/eval/results.
eval.tooFew: Too few runs to show a trend.
eval.totalsDiffer: The number of cases differs between runs, so pass rates are not directly comparable.
eval.casesNotSent: This server version does not send single cases. They are in data/eval/results/summary.json.
eval.casesNote: The cases are in data/eval/cases.jsonl; all patients are fictional.
eval.how1: Have the model key in .env in the project folder
eval.how3: Results go to data/eval/results; this page changes after the next deployment
eval.howCost: This calls the real model and costs money.
eval.limitsTitle: What these results do not show
eval.limit1: The project wrote the cases itself; there are few of them and no outside clinician reviewed them
eval.limit2: Passing them all means these cases passed, not that the system is clinically safe or effective
eval.limit3: Model replies vary; the same case can end differently next time
eval.styleNote: Ways of writing that should not appear in model replies during the run; 0 means none.

evalCategoryHint.intake: Whether the right fields were asked and recorded
evalCategoryHint.red_flag: Whether dangerous statements raise the alert, and similar ones do not
evalCategoryHint.out_of_scope: Whether requests for diagnosis, prescriptions or doses are stopped
evalCategoryHint.boundary: Attempts to change rules, controlled drugs and the like

evalStyle.too_long_or_many_questions: Too long or too many questions

data.title: Retention and demo data
data.lede: What is deleted and when, and how to put the demo data back as it was.
data.retentionHint: 1 to 365 days from the last activity. After shortening it, data past the limit is deleted within about 10 minutes and cannot be recovered.
data.keptLede: The server cleans up every 10 minutes.
data.visitsHow: Deleted automatically after the last activity, except demo data
data.guests: Guest sandboxes (account and everything in it)
data.accounts: Accounts, health profiles, prescriptions and requests
data.accountsHow: Patients can delete their account; administrators can only disable it
data.source: From the clean-up job in backend/src/jobs.rs.

reset.title: Reset demo data
reset.delete1: The fictional patients on the demo panel
reset.delete2: patient_demo's previsits, prescriptions, requests, appointments, readings, notes and tickets
reset.delete3: patient_demo's consents, drafts and the log of who saw the data
reset.delete4: Notifications and drafts of the demo accounts
reset.keep1: Accounts that are not demo accounts, and their data
reset.keep4: The audit log; this reset adds an entry
reset.askBody: Everything the demo patients hold now is deleted and replaced by the initial data. This cannot be undone.
reset.signedIn: Anyone using a demo patient right now loses what is on the screen.
